mapper.insert: INSERT INTO observation_session (student_id, creator_id, observation_date, course_code, course_other_description, environment_code, environment_other_description, observation_duration_minutes, period_behavior_remark) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{creatorId}, #{observationDate}, #{courseCode}, #{courseOtherDescription}, #{environmentCode}, #{environmentOtherDescription}, #{observationDurationMinutes}, #{periodBehaviorRemark})
mapper.select: SELECT os.id, os.student_id, os.creator_id, os.observation_date, os.course_code, ct.label AS course_label, os.course_other_description, os.environment_code, et.label AS environment_label, os.environment_other_description, os.observation_duration_minutes, os.period_behavior_remark FROM observation_session os JOIN course_type ct ON ct.code = os.course_code JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = os.environment_code WHERE os.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE observation_session SET observation_date = #{observationDate}, course_code = #{courseCode}, course_other_description = #{courseOtherDescription}, environment_code = #{environmentCode}, environment_other_description = #{environmentOtherDescription}, observation_duration_minutes = #{observationDurationMinutes}, period_behavior_remark = #{periodBehaviorRemark} WHERE id = #{id}
